race.description: Mon Natural Foods Mark Goring Memorial Hcp (56)
race.comment: DEVINE GRUNT (1) looks the horse to beat after going within a long neck of Spirit Angel at Geelong, and that margin had extra merit given he was held up passing the 150m. He had also placed at Yarra Valley the start prior, so his form this campaign is reliable, he'll be hard to hold out. PENDANTE (7) brings the most consistent profile, with a St Arnaud BM52 win followed by a narrow Mildura second, and her record around this trip reads well.  PRESTIGE GEOFFREY (3) comes off a well-supported BM52 win at Wangaratta and looks capable of notching up another victory. STRUMMER (2) drops out of a BM66 second at Albury and has been building nicely, this trip is an unknown but he'll be on speed giving a sight. STOLE HIM (4) has struggled his past two but is better than that and could improve.
